title: Law to phase out horse-drawn carriages by 2028
summary: This bill would ban new or renewed licenses for carriage horses, horse-drawn cabs and their drivers starting June 1, 2028, ending any existing licenses on that date. It requires carriage horses be disposed of humanely, barring sale for slaughter or reuse in the industry. The city must create a transition plan by April 1, 2027 to help owners, drivers and stable workers, including possible compensation and workforce assistance.
